bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January 2013 to 30 June 2013'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2013.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 113,339,455,464 + Total Equity 12,325,780,967 = Total Assets 125,665,236,431); Profit before tax 721,619,664 - Provision for tax 518,824,219 = Profit after tax 202,795,445, matching the filing's own EPS of 0.27. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2012' column (Total Assets BDT 125,841.50mn, Total Equity BDT 12,135.82mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2012_Q4.json exactly. DISCREPANCY FOUND: this filing's comparative '01 January 2012 to 30 June 2012' P&L column shows Interest paid on deposits and borrowings of BDT 4,624,490,484 (Net interest income BDT 1,018,369,494) for H1 2012, whereas the 2012_Q2.json record (sourced from H1 2012's own contemporaneous filing) shows Interest paid of BDT 4,749,412,035 (Net interest income BDT 893,447,943) for the identical period -- a restatement of about BDT 125mn discovered one year later with no explicit 'restated' label in this filing. Per project convention, the 2012_Q2.json record's contemporaneous figures remain authoritative and were not changed.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF: standalone Balance Sheet 'As at 30 June 2013' and standalone Profit and Loss Account 'For the half-year/quarter ended 30 June 2013' (pdftotext -layout lines 59-115 and 176-235 of the extracted text).
